ONE DESK uses Automation to move files, send items to the Trash, open requested commands and control playback in your media apps.

ONE DESK uses system audio for the mixer, music bars, recordings, and Live Translate sessions you start. Live Translate uses Apple Speech and sends recognized text to MyMemory only after your consent.
ONE DESK uses Bluetooth only to read the battery level of connected peripherals. Nothing leaves your Mac.
ONE DESK transcribes the audio you explicitly start in Live Translate to produce live subtitles.

ONE DESK uses your microphone for recordings or Live Translate sessions you start. Live Translate uses Apple Speech (on device when supported) and sends recognized text to MyMemory after your consent.
Show your upcoming appointments in the notch. Calendar events stay on this Mac.
ONE DESK shows your camera only in the preview window you open, so you can check how you look before a call. Nothing is recorded or leaves your Mac.
ONE DESK checks local metadata in Downloads to review, organize or trash only confirmed WhatsApp files you choose. The Cleaner also looks for forgotten screenshots when you save screenshots here.
ONE DESK organizes confirmed WhatsApp downloads in a destination folder you explicitly choose. The Cleaner also looks for forgotten screenshots when you save screenshots here.
